raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Allow the GLM-5.3-Flash fused shared-expert path (`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1`) at TP2 on gfx950. AITER now has tuned fused-MoE configs for the TP2 fused shape: block FP8 in ROCm/aiter#6077 (in AITER v0.1.26) and MXFP4 in ROCm/aiter#6435. Follows #59221. Carried in our GLM-5.3-Flash MI355X builds since 2026-10-14 as amd-sriram/vllm#41.

## Claims

- At TP2 on gfx950, the flag now runs the shared expert inside the AITER fused MoE (289 experts, top-k 9). Before, the gate ignored it with a warning and ran the shared expert as a separate MLP.
- Unchanged: the flag default (off), TP1/TP16, other GPUs, and data, prefill-context or expert parallelism.
- GLM-5.3-Flash MXFP4, 2x MI355X, TP2: +3.6% geomean throughput over a 15-point sweep (8k, 60k and 128k inputs); +5 to +8% at 8k/1k, concurrency 8 to 128. GPQA and NIAH unchanged.

## Validation

**Unit test.** `pytest tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py` on MI355X (gfx950), with this PR's test file and `model.py` from current main (both files unchanged since nightly c50aca14):
- This PR: `106 passed`.
- Without the `model.py` change: `1 failed, 105 passed`. The failure is `test_glm5_next_fuses_shared_experts_only_in_tuned_setups[tensor_parallel_size-2-None]`.

**Serving A/B, 2x MI355X, TP2, `amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4`.**
- Two images built from the same recipe (same vLLM base and AITER commit, which includes ROCm/aiter#6435); the only difference is this change. Flag on in both arms; without this change it is ignored at TP2.
- One server launch per arm, one run per point. Earlier repeat runs on this setup varied by about ±1%.
- Logs: the baseline logs the "flag ignored" warning and runs only the 288-expert / top-k 8 MoE; with this change, no warning and only the 289-expert / top-k 9 MoE. Both shapes use tuned FlyDSL MXFP4 kernels from ROCm/aiter#6435.
- Client: `sglang.bench_serve --backend vllm`, random, range ratio 0.8, 32 to 768 prompts per point, warmup equal to concurrency.

Output throughput (tok/s, both GPUs), TPOT in brackets:

| ISL / OSL | Concurrency | Baseline | This PR | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 8k / 1k | 4 | 475.8 (7.93 ms) | 479.3 (7.88 ms) | +0.7% |
| 8k / 1k | 8 | 673.2 (11.36 ms) | 724.6 (10.52 ms) | +7.6% |
| 8k / 1k | 16 | 1012.8 (14.79 ms) | 1076.9 (13.86 ms) | +6.3% |
| 8k / 1k | 32 | 1359.7 (21.42 ms) | 1463.8 (19.80 ms) | +7.7% |
| 8k / 1k | 64 | 1763.2 (32.88 ms) | 1854.9 (31.17 ms) | +5.2% |
| 8k / 1k | 128 | 2035.4 (54.69 ms) | 2144.3 (51.93 ms) | +5.3% |
| 8k / 1k | 256 | 2349.5 (93.75 ms) | 2401.0 (91.59 ms) | +2.2% |
| 60k / 600 | 4 to 32 | | | +1.8 to +3.3% |
| 128k / 1k | 4 to 32 | | | +1.4 to +2.9% |
| **Geomean, 15 points** | | 7943.9 tok/s/GPU | 8230.0 tok/s/GPU | **+3.6%** |

Accuracy, same launches:

| Eval | Baseline | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| GPQA Diamond (n=198, thinking on, SE ±2.9 pp per arm) | 87.9% | 88.9% |
| NIAH single_2, 65536 | 1.0 | 1.0 |

<details>
<summary>Server command</summary>

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4 VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_USE_FLYDSL=1 \
AITER_CONFIG_FMOE=<aiter>/configs/model_configs/glm5_fp4_tuned_fmoe.csv:<aiter>/configs/model_configs/glm53flash_fp4_tuned_fmoe.csv \
vllm serve amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 --kv-cache-dtype bfloat16 \
  --compilation-config '{"custom_ops": ["+fused_rms_norm_gated"]}' \
  --enable-chunked-prefill --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --max-num-seqs 256 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --max-model-len 258048 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching --reasoning-parser glm45 --monokernel
```

</details>

**Not measured:** the block-FP8 checkpoint at TP2. **Not in CI:** the serving check needs 2x gfx950.

## Details

- **Why the gate refused TP2.** #59221 allowed fusion only where AITER had tuned configs for the fused shape (TP4/TP8 on gfx950); without them the fused MoE runs default kernels. The per-rank intermediate size at TP2 is 1024. ROCm/aiter#6077 (block FP8, in v0.1.26) and ROCm/aiter#6435 (MXFP4) add rows at that size.
- **Correctness at TP2.** Without EP, the shared expert is split by TP like the routed experts, and the extra top-k column is the same on every rank. Nothing on the fused path depends on TP size.
- **Base stack.** The A/B ran on a nightly from 2026-10-14 with other GLM-5.3-Flash ROCm PRs applied (#50535, #59478, #58064, #61662), the same in both arms. TODO: repeat the A/B on a plain nightly once vLLM's AITER pin includes ROCm/aiter#6435.
- **Scope.** Only the gate in `vllm/models/glm5next/common/model.py` and its test.

**Related work:** #63603 makes the same gate change; #60604 changes the same TP check for gfx942.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

files.patch:
@@ -894,7 +894,7 @@ def test_models_fse_init(
 
         for attention in ("Glm5NextLinearAttention", "Glm5NextMLAAttention"):
             monkeypatch.setattr(glm5_next_model, attention, _StubGlm5NextAttention)
-        # The gate allows fusion only at TP4/TP8 on gfx950, and this test
+        # The gate allows fusion only at TP2/TP4/TP8 on gfx950, and this test
         # runs at TP1; the gate has its own test.
         monkeypatch.setattr(
             glm5_next_model, "_fused_shared_experts_tuned", lambda _: True
@@ -984,7 +984,8 @@ def test_models_fse_init(
     [
         ("tensor_parallel_size", 4, None),
         ("tensor_parallel_size", 8, None),
-        ("tensor_parallel_size", 2, "tensor_parallel_size is 2"),
+        ("tensor_parallel_size", 2, None),
+        ("tensor_parallel_size", 1, "tensor_parallel_size is 1"),
         ("data_parallel_size", 2, "data_parallel_size is 2"),
         ("prefill_context_parallel_size", 2, "prefill_context_parallel_size is 2"),
         ("enable_expert_parallel", True, "expert parallelism is enabled"),

@@ -1297,15 +1297,15 @@ def get_spec_layer_idx_from_weight_name(
 def _fused_shared_experts_tuned(parallel_config: ParallelConfig) -> bool:
     """AITER has fused-MoE configs tuned for the fused shared-expert shape
     (one more expert and one more top-k slot than the routed MoE) only on
-    gfx950, with every expert on each rank and its weights split by TP4 or
-    TP8. Data, prefill context and expert parallelism change that split, so
+    gfx950, with every expert on each rank and its weights split by TP2, TP4
+    or TP8. Data, prefill context and expert parallelism change that split, so
     any other GPU or parallel layout would run untuned fallback kernels."""
     from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
 
     reasons: list[str] = []
     if not on_gfx950():
         reasons.append("the GPU is not gfx950")
-    if parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size not in (4, 8):
+    if parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size not in (2, 4, 8):
         reasons.append(
             f"tensor_parallel_size is {parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size}"
         )
@@ -1324,7 +1324,7 @@ def _fused_shared_experts_tuned(parallel_config: ParallelConfig) -> bool:
     logger.warning_once(
         "VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS is ignored for GLM-5.3-Flash: "
         "%s. AITER has tuned configs for its fused shared-expert MoE only on "
-        "gfx950 at TP4 and TP8, without data, prefill context or expert "
+        "gfx950 at TP2, TP4 and TP8, without data, prefill context or expert "
         "parallelism. Running the shared experts as a separate MLP.",
         "; ".join(reasons),
     )
